theorem _root_.CompressionEval.fresh_algebra_groups_03 {G : Type*} [Group G] (a b : G) (h : a * b = 1) :
  b * a = 1 ∧ a⁻¹ = b :=
by
  have hb : b = a⁻¹ := by
    calc
      b = a⁻¹ * (a * b) := by group
      _ = a⁻¹ := by rw [h]; simp
  subst b
  simp
